description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific operations for image upgrades in an embedded Linux system, including image validation, copying configuration, and performing upgrades with partition handling and device manipulation.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks and compares partition tables in an image to determine if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to a mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade by writing images to device partitions, handling partition table changes, and copying bootloader images.
